diagrams.name: overview
diagrams.title: RoboGuide 系统总览
diagrams.topology: Top: user -> MI -> Orchestration. Controller container encloses Orchestration, Control, Runtime, Integration, State/Memory Catalog, Artifact CAS. Main command chain Orchestration -> Control -> Runtime -> Integration -> Node Service -> Local EAIOS. Node Service is outside Controller. Providers connect locally to Node Service. Facts flow back Node Service -> Integration -> State/Memory Catalog; State/Memory Catalog supplies read-only evidence to Control. Content flows Artifact CAS <-> Node Service with two clearly labeled directional arrows. Do not put Local EAIOS inside Controller. Providers do not directly allocate resources.

diagrams.name: mission-planning
diagrams.title: 从对话到经过审查的计划
nodes: 执行授权 / 风险审批
diagrams.topology: Number the main path 1 to 8: Chat -> Mission Request -> Grounding -> Interpreter -> Planner -> Reviewer -> Read-only preflight -> Execute grant/Risk approval -> Controller admission. Reviewer -> Bounded Repair -> Reviewer is an explicit bounded loop. Interpreter clarification returns to Chat. Label preflight as read-only; it reserves no resources. Exact displayed plan revision/digest binds authorization. Show Request and Controller Mission as distinct boundaries, not one identity. No direct model-to-device arrow.

diagrams.name: dispatch
diagrams.title: 从候选到可靠执行
nodes: 持久 ACK / 执行事实
diagrams.topology: Left-to-right numbered main chain of all nodes: Ready Task -> Match -> Bounded Scheduler -> Proposal -> Control Commit/Bind -> SQL Checkpoint+Outbox -> Send Execute -> Node Journal -> Local Workflow. Use two rows for readability. Put Commit/Bind and SQL inside a single Controller writer transaction boundary. Send Execute must be outside and after committed SQL. From Node Journal return Durable ACK to Controller; Local Workflow returns execution facts through Node Journal to Controller. Add two concise callouts: Proposal does not reserve; Journal before local effects. Do not conflate ACK and successful physical execution.

diagrams.name: completion
diagrams.title: 完成判定与资源释放
nodes: Control 释放 Task 资源
Mission 原目标 / 整组收尾
diagrams.topology: A clear branching and joining flow: Local Completed -> AwaitingSatisfaction -> Plan-declared Basis; branch to execution-report OR independent verifier evidence (only the declared basis is accepted). Both branches lead toward TaskSatisfied but a separate Memory revoke gate is a mandatory conditional gate when Memory is used, drawn joining before TaskSatisfied. TaskSatisfied -> Control releases Task resources -> Advance successor Task -> Original Mission goal/Group closure. A concise bottom note: missing or negative evidence retains ownership. Do not claim local Completed alone proves the goal. Mission closure also needs all tasks and any configured original-goal gate.

diagrams.name: state-memory
diagrams.title: State、Memory 与空间内容
nodes: 实时视图 / 受保护证据
diagrams.topology: Use two clearly separated lanes. Evidence lane: Node observations -> State Source/TTL -> Live view/Protected evidence. Content lane: Memory Catalog references Scope/Visibility/Placement metadata and Artifact CAS opaque bytes. Artifact CAS -> Spatial fusion Provider -> Artifact CAS produces a NEW immutable revision; distinguish input and output arrows. Artifact CAS -> Consumer Node/Provider -> Prepare/Import -> Current Use/Revoke. Memory Catalog supplies selection metadata to Prepare/Import. Do not draw a raw bytes path through Runtime or put bytes inside State. Include short note: Reference != Import != Current use. Catalog metadata never grants content authorization.

diagrams.name: recovery
diagrams.title: 未知、停止与分级恢复
nodes: 经 Review 的 Plan Revision
diagrams.topology: Top chain Disconnect/Failure -> Unknown/Hold -> Retain original ownership -> Original Cancel/Revoke intent -> Stop evidence + Original terminal -> Gate checks. After gate checks show TWO distinct authorized paths: Role Recovery -> Match/Commit/Rebind, and Reviewed Plan Revision -> New Group/Normal admission. If evidence, authorization or original budget is unavailable, Gate checks -> Manual Escalation, with ownership retained. No arrow from Unknown straight to Execute. Add a small separate bottom bar: Local EAIOS owns immediate safety. Show command receipt and stop observation as separate evidence, not the same step.

diagrams.name: cooperation
diagrams.title: 四种协作模式
nodes: 独立任务 / 标准 DAG
共享视图 / 关系围栏
边缘 UDP 同步控制
共同 UTC 编排 · 独立 Mission
diagrams.topology: Four equal numbered panels, each mode heading connects only to its own mechanism. Mode1 -> independent tasks/normal DAG. Mode2 -> TaskSatisfied+Memory handoff. Mode3 -> Shared view/Relation fences. Mode4 -> PeerChannel readiness gate -> Edge UDP sync control. Show Controller and Edge separation inside Mode4: the readiness gate is Control-side, UDP control is Local/provider-side; high-rate motion packets bypass Controller. Separate bottom strip Shared UTC playback/Separate Missions belongs to Independent mode, NOT a fifth mode and not Mode4. Include short note that per-performer Missions provide fleet fault isolation; same-Mission failure retains Mission-wide stop behavior.

diagrams.name: deployment
diagrams.title: 进程、存储与故障域
diagrams.topology: Draw software process containers and their OWN distinct storage. Mission Service -> Controller using HTTP; Mission Service attaches Request SQL. Controller attaches Controller SQL/Checkpoint and Artifact CAS. Controller <-> Node Service via gRPC using two directional labeled arrows; Node Service owns Node Journal and connects to Local EAIOS/Providers. Dashed optional area Replica Quorum connects to Controller metadata/content durability, not to robot execution. Another dashed optional Controller domain connects via Federation. Quiescent Recovery Tool reads declared closed storage/content into a separate backup/restore box represented by the label itself, never connects to actuators. Short note: Process != Host != Node != PhysicalEntity. No concrete IPs, credentials, physical failover claims or claim that storage v3 and replication are automatically combined.
